decisions.reason: It remained on the website across 2023 and 2024 in a core category, so its performance appears at least satisfactory enough relative to aspiration levels to justify keeping a differentiated design option in the range.

Its promotion from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024 signals results above internal aspirations and a strong fit with the firm's strategy of multifunctional, system-oriented architectural hardware.

Although it shows weaker prominence than the more celebrated handle lines, it is still in the firm's core offer and likely benefits from organisational slack and portfolio logic unless clearer underperformance emerges.
This collection has dedicated visibility and repeated design-award recognition, indicating performance clearly above aspiration levels and making withdrawal highly unlikely.
